input.title: ZM3D Halloween - iPad 12.9" store screenshot set
input.description:
Halloween version of the live App Store iPad 12.9" screenshot set (live since Sep 17). The iPhone 6.5" and Google Play phone Halloween sets are already exported in Drive > ZM3D Halloween 2025 > Store; the iPad set is the one store set still missing.

**Direction (Robert, Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025):** same comps as the live iPad set with only the seasonal layer on top — pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment. Same flat background, pose, zombie order and CTA. Must sit on current art (Android #1452 / iOS 1232 or later).

**Due: Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT** — iOS screenshots can only change with a new version, so this has to go up with the Oct 17 submission (merge cut Oct 16 12:00 PT, per Arthur's Q4 release calendar). Live with the build from ~Wed Oct 22. Reverts with the Nov 6 submission.

Export to Drive > ZM3D Halloween 2025 > Store, same naming as the iPhone set (ZM3D_Halloween_iPad129_NN_2048x2732.png).

Part of the ZM3D Halloween plan (Claire).

input.title: ZM3D Halloween - app icon (App Store + Google Play)
input.description:
Halloween version of the live ZM3D app icon (App Store + Google Play, live since Sep 17). No Halloween icon exists yet.

**Direction:** Robert's note on the Sep 17 Halloween concept still applies: "a Halloween icon should stay as simple as the one we have". So only the seasonal layer changes (e.g. a pumpkin or a light fog/prop accent) on the current icon. Same composition, character and silhouette, and it has to read at small sizes. Per Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025.

**Due: Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT**, the merge cut for the Oct 17 submission. That's the last build that can carry Halloween changes (Arthur's Q4 release calendar).

**Timing note:** Leonard suggested swapping around Oct 24. Because the icon ships in the build, it goes live when the Oct 17 build clears Apple review, planned for ~Wed Oct 22. It can't be timed separately for the 24th without another build. Upload the Google Play listing icon the same day so both stores match. The normal icon comes back with the Nov 6 submission.

Deliver all required sizes (iOS app icon set + Google Play 512x512) to Drive > ZM3D Halloween 2025 > Store.

Part of the ZM3D Halloween plan (Claire).

insertText.text:
ZM3D Halloween 2025 — art plan
Owner: Claire Morgan (Art Lead). For the Halloween review, Thu Oct 2, 9:00 PT. Please comment inline.
Tracker (every item, call, owner and date): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rpB8BgFxuYa8e2c6WQ6KHUs9WLr6BKjyQCZsIN5_BuY/edit

Goal
Leonard asked (#zombie_marketing, Sep 30) for everything players see from Zombie Match 3D to look like Halloween for the last stretch of October: the store pages and every ad we're running. This plan covers everything live on Oct 1. For each item it gives the Halloween call, what has to happen first, what we already have, and who makes what by when.

What this is built on
- ZM3D live creatives sheet (Frederick): 4 store surfaces and 56 Unity rows, plus each ad's ART ticket notes (capture build, master, campaigns).
- Two live ads that aren't on the sheet: julia 4:5 "They're coming, stop them!" (ART-826), still on iOS UK and our best CPI there (Frederick on the Trello card, Sep 30), and Marcus's portrait UA end card (ART-831), which plays after every Android US phone video (ticket note, Sep 29). That makes 58 live ads.
- Frederick's October UA plan (Sep 12), plus his Sep 29 restart note and Sep 30 changes. The Sep 30 changes override the draft: the Halloween flight is now Sat Oct 18 to Fri Oct 31 on iOS UK phone, iOS UK tablet and Android US phone. Android US tablet ends Sun Oct 12. Every Halloween ad is due to Frederick by Wed Oct 15, not the 17th.
- Arthur's Q4 release calendar: the Oct 17 submission is the last build that can carry Halloween (merge cut Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT). iOS screenshots only change with a new version. Apple review takes up to 3 days, so the build is live ~Wed Oct 22. Google Play listing graphics can go up any day with a 1-day review. The Nov 6 submission puts things back to normal.
- Robert's Seasonal art direction — Q4 2025: dress only current art. Anything from a build older than Android #1452 / iOS 1232 (the Jul 29 zombie swap with the new background) is redone first, and a newer capture of the same thing counts. Masters with music baked in get re-cut from a no-music master first. Only the seasonal layer changes (pumpkins, fog, props, title treatment); background, pose, zombie order and CTA stay the same so variants test clean.

How the calls work (Robert's four)
- Halloween version: dress it from the current art.
- Refresh first: re-capture, re-render or re-cut before any seasonal pass.
- Reuse: it already has a seasonal version, so use that one.
- Skip: no seasonal version this time. Here that means anything that only runs on Android US tablet, since that campaign ends Oct 12, before the flight.

Store pages
- App icon (App Store + Google Play): Halloween version, new. Owner Martin, ART-856. No Halloween icon exists. Robert ruled the Sep 17 concept too busy for an icon, so it stays as simple as the current one with just a seasonal accent. The icon ships in the build, so the art is due at the Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT merge cut and goes live with the Oct 17 build, ~Wed Oct 22. Leonard, on "swap around the 24th": that would need a separate build after the last Halloween one, so ~Oct 22 is the realistic swap. Upload the Google Play listing icon the same day so the stores match. It reverts with the Nov 6 submission.
- iPhone 6.5" set: Reuse. Martin exported 5 Halloween screens on Sep 30 (same comps, seasonal layer). Done, so no ticket. Arthur: this set must go in the Oct 17 submission. Live ~Oct 22, reverts Nov 6.
- iPad 12.9" set: Halloween version, new. Owner Martin, ART-855. It's the one store set not in the Halloween folder. Due Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT, rides the Oct 17 submission, live ~Oct 22.
- Google Play phone set: Reuse. Martin exported 6 Halloween screens on Sep 30. Done, so no ticket. It isn't tied to a build, so I propose uploading Fri Oct 17 to go live with the ad flight on Sat Oct 18 (owner to confirm at the review). Swap back Nov 1 or with the Nov 6 submission.

Ads (58 live today)
- 13 Halloween version, all Marcus: the ads already on current captures with SFX-only masters. That's cheer fastcouch 9:16 / 16:9 / 4:5 (ART-808/816/851), marcus.bennett 16:9 / 4:5 / 1:1 (ART-817/818/819), barrel marketing2 1:1 (ART-852), couch alpha 50 4:5 (ART-853), balloons alpha 50 (1) 16:9 (ART-854), and end card 001 in 9:16 / 16:9 / 1:1 / 4:5 (ART-833/834/835/848). All due to Frederick Wed Oct 15.
- 35 Refresh first: 29 for Marcus (videos and end cards), 6 for Martin (the julia statics). Almost all were captured on April-July builds or the Dec 2024 prototype, before the zombie swap. Seven also have music baked in (balloons alpha 50, barrel alpha 30, couch marketing2 30s, couch alpha 30 endcard, cheer 30p 9:16 and 4:5, marcus.bennett 9:16). marcus.bennett 9:16 is on a current capture and only needs a re-cut from Marcus's Aug 13 no-music export. The portrait UA end card (ART-831) is from #1450, two builds before the swap. Refreshes are due Wed Oct 8 so Robert can check them, then the Halloween pass goes to Frederick by Wed Oct 15.
- 0 Reuse. Marcus's Sep 29 cheer fastcouch Halloween test (9:16 + 16:9 in UA masters) can't ship: it was cut on the July capture with the old background (Robert, Sep 30). Marcus is redoing both from the Sep 16 #1896 capture, so those count as Halloween versions.
- 10 Skip: barrel marketing2 16:9, cheer 30p 16:9, couch alpha 30 16:9, balloons alpha 50 16:9, barrel alpha 30 endcard 16:9, boris fastcouch 16:9, couch marketing2 30s 16:9, julia 1:1 android tablet, and squirrelfail landscape / mrfluffernot landscape. Frederick pulled those last two off iOS UK tablet on Sep 29, so they now only run on Android US tablet.

Shortcuts for the refreshes
- couch alpha 50 (ART-795) and its 16:9 (ART-823): use the Sep 23 #1935 capture of the same edit (ART-853).
- balloons alpha 50 (1) (ART-797): use the Sep 25 #1966 capture (ART-854).
- barrel marketing2 4:5 (ART-805): use the Sep 17 #1896 export (ART-852).
- boris fastcouch 9:16 (ART-840): keep the Sep 11 Boris opening and rebuild the gameplay on the Sep 16 #1896 fastcouch re-capture.
- marcus.bennett 9:16 (ART-809): re-cut from the Aug 13 no-music export (InvestorFacing_Seq3_NoMusic).

Who makes what by when
- Martin Walsh (icon and stills): Halloween icon (ART-856) and iPad 12.9" set (ART-855) by Thu Oct 16, 12:00 PT. Julia statics ART-825/826/827/828/829/830: refreshed by Wed Oct 8, Halloween versions to Frederick by Wed Oct 15. ART-826 comes first, since it's our best iOS UK CPI.
- Marcus Bennett (video and end cards): 13 Halloween versions and 29 refresh-first videos/end cards. Refreshes by Wed Oct 8, everything to Frederick by Wed Oct 15. Start with the iOS UK phone and Android US phone 9:16s, since they cover two of the three flight campaigns.
- Frederick Stone: uploads to Unity and gets approval between Oct 15 and the flight start on Oct 18. Each ad's ART ticket has a comment with its call and due date, and the new-work tickets are assigned to the maker, so the upload queue can be read straight off Linear.
- Arthur Blake: put the Halloween icon plus the iPhone 6.5" and iPad 12.9" sets in the Oct 17 submission, and the normal ones back in the Nov 6 submission.
- Robert: sign off the refreshes by Oct 8 and the Halloween passes before Oct 15.
- Claire Morgan: owns the plan and tracker, reviews art against Robert's direction, and chases dates.

Risks and decisions for Thursday
1. Marcus's load. 42 video/end card deliverables in two weeks, 29 of them needing a re-capture or re-cut first, is the biggest risk to Oct 15. Options: (a) get help with the re-captures (Julia has done gameplay captures for UA before; Frederick cut most of the original edits), (b) cut low performers from the flight instead of dressing them; Frederick, which ones would you drop? (c) prioritise phone 9:16s and let lower-spend tablet variants run un-themed. I need a decision at the review.
2. Icon date. ~Oct 22 with the build, not Oct 24 (see Store pages). Leonard to confirm that's fine.
3. Google Play listing timing and owner: proposed Fri Oct 17 upload for an Oct 18 go-live, with the swap back on Nov 1.
4. Live creatives sheet gaps: ART-826 and ART-831 are live but missing from Frederick's sheet. Worth adding them so the Halloween uploads track cleanly.
5. Wind-down: the flight ends Fri Oct 31. Frederick to swap the normal ads back in on Nov 1. The store reverts with the Nov 6 submission.

Halloween plan + tracker are ready for Thursday's review, all of you have comment access :jack_o_lantern:
• Plan: https://docs.google.com/document/d/ed560819ef06efd26407ce4c/edit
• Tracker: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1rpB8BgFxuYa8e2c6WQ6KHUs9WLr6BKjyQCZsIN5_BuY/edit

**Store:** the iPhone 6.5" and Google Play phone sets are already done (Martin's Sep 30 exports), so we reuse them. New store art tickets, both Martin, due Thu Oct 16 12:00 PT for the Oct 17 build:
• Halloween app icon: https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-856
• iPad 12.9" set: https://linear.app/harmonygames/issue/ART-855
On the icon swap: it ships in the build, so it goes live with the Oct 17 build around Wed Oct 22, not the 24th, unless we do another build.

**Ads:** 58 live (56 on the sheet plus julia 4:5 ART-826 and the portrait end card ART-831, which aren't on it). Following Frederick's Sep 30 changes (flight Oct 18-31, Android US tablet ends Oct 12, everything due to him Wed Oct 15):
• 13 Halloween version (Marcus)
• 35 refresh first, because they're on pre-Jul 29 captures and/or have music baked in (29 Marcus, 6 Martin). Refreshes due Oct 8.
• 10 skip, because they only run on Android US tablet
• Marcus's cheer fastcouch test can't be reused (old July capture), so he's redoing it from Sep 16
Every ad's ART ticket has a comment with its call and due date, and the 48 that need work are assigned to Marcus or Martin, so <@EMPLOYEE_0008_SLACK_ID> can build the upload queue from Linear.

Biggest thing to decide Thursday: Marcus has 42 video deliverables by Oct 15. Options are in the plan.
